title: Ijwi Mbere y'Inkubi y'umuyaga
intro: Umuntu wari mu butayu yarahagurutse kugira ngo ahamagare igihugu gikomeye kugaruka mu kuri. Abaturage bari bazwiho inyubako nziza n'imbaraga zitagereranywa. Nyamara ubwibone bwabo bwarabahumye amaso, banze kumva. Amaherezo, igihano gikomeye cyarabagezeho, kirokoka itsinda rito ry'abizera.
clues: Noherejwe mu bantu b'ibihangange babaga mu misozi miremire kandi bazwiho imbaraga zabo.
Ubwoko bwanjye bwaje bukurikiye ubundi bwoko bukomeye bwari bwararimbuwe.
Bari bafite inyubako nziza cyane kandi bubatse iminara miremire.
Nabahamagariye gusenga Imana Imwe, ariko banze kureka ibigirwamana byabo.
Igihano gikomeye cyarabagezeho, kidasiga gusa abizeye hamwe nanjye.
Ni njye woherejwe ku bwoko bukomeye buzwi nka Aad.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Umuriro wo mu ijuru uturutse hejuru

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Ubwoko bwanjye bwashenywe n'umuyaga ukomeye, mu gihe nanjye nakijijwe
Abantu banjye bakubiswe n'umutingito w'isi bararira
Abantu banjye batewe amabuye aturutse mu ijuru
Abantu banjye bajugunywe mu muriro ugurumana
outcome.answer: Ubwoko bwanjye bwashenywe n'umuyaga ukomeye, mu gihe nanjye nakijijwe

arabic: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَن جَآءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنكُمْ لِيُنذِرَكُمْ ۚ وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍۢ وَزَادَكُمْ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ بَصْۜطَةًۭ ۖ فَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ ءَالَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verse: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allāh that you might succeed." (7:69)
